name: @w6w-apps/connecteam
description: Manage Connecteam's deskless workforce: employees, time clock, scheduling, forms and tasks.

w6w.longDescription:
Connecteam is deskless workforce management: employee directory, GPS time clock, shift scheduling, digital forms and task boards for teams that don't sit at a desk.

This app covers Connecteam's REST API v1 (`api.connecteam.com`) end to end for the surfaces a workflow needs most: read, create, update and archive employees; clock a user in and out and read or write their time-clock entries and timesheet totals; list, create, update and delete shifts on a schedule; read forms and their submissions; and list, create and update tasks on a task board.

Every action stays inside what the vendor's own OpenAPI document declares — no endpoint here was inferred from a sibling integration or guessed from a UI screenshot.
